sentences.text: The prosecution case as disclosed in the First Information Report is that the accused Saurabh Kumar Jaiswal impersonated as one Sonu Kumar Jaiswal and sold a land measuring 3 acres and 166 decimal to the complainant by such impersonation.

The petitioners Chitranjan Kumar Jaiswal,
Tuntun Kumar Kapri and Rajendra Mandal are said to be the purchaser, identifier and the witness on the said sale deed which was executed on 06.02.2023.

However, when the complainant subsequently sold the land in the joint names of Dinesh Mandal and Ritesh Mandal and when the vendee approached the revenue officer for getting the land mutated in their name, they were informed that the alleged land has already been sold by the petitioner no. 4 on 06.02.2023.
7.

It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioners that so far as petitioner no. 1 is concerned, he is the purchaser as per the sale deed dated 06.02.2023 and he himself is a victim circumstances as he has lost both land and money.

So far as Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.86248 of 2024(3)
dt.09-05-2025 other two petitioners are concerned, they are only the identifier and the witness of the sale deed and the thrust of the allegation is against the petitioner no. 4 Saurabh Kumar Jaiswal.

It has also been submitted that the nature of case is predominantly civil and civil remedies are available to the complainant.
8.
Learned APP for the State has opposed the application for anticipatory bail.

9. Taking into consideration that the petitioners are only the innocent purchaser, identifier and witness and the allegations are civil in nature, let the above named petitioners in the event of their arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Complaint Case No. 156 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C./482(2) of the B.N.S.S. (Soni Shrivastava, J) devendra/-
